title: Organizational Learning in Materials Discovery Campaigns: Utilizing Databases, Calculations, and Group Members to Advance Discovery
description: Figure scripts, result files, producing code and inputs for the paper "Organizational Learning in Materials Discovery Campaigns: Utilizing Databases, Calculations, and Group Members to Advance Discovery" (Materials Genome Engineering Advances (Wiley); preprint on arXiv, cs.LG). Taylor D. Sparks acknowledges support from the Army Research Office Materials Design, under Contract No. W911NF-23-1-0333.
notes: Code (Python, shell and SLURM scripts) is released under the MIT License (LICENSE). Data, result files and figures are released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0.txt). The archived third-party datasets (Materials Project, JARVIS-DFT, SNUMAT, the Zhuo et al. experimental compilation) keep their own terms; their sources are cited in the paper.
